Citation engine for DOCXMD (loaded on demand by js/cite.js, cached offline by the service worker).

citeproc.js   citeproc-js 2.4.63 by Frank Bennett — unmodified copy of citeproc_commonjs.js from
              npm "citeproc". Licensed CPAL-1.0 or AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE-citeproc.txt).
              citeproc-js implements the Citation Style Language — https://citationstyles.org/
styles/       CSL styles. apa, ieee, vancouver (= nlm-citation-sequence), harvard-cite-them-right,
              chicago-author-date, modern-language-association: Citation Style Language project,
              https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles — CC BY-SA 3.0, authors in each file.
              dstu-8302-2015.csl: "DSTU 8302:2015" by Yuriy Nabasov (PUET),
              https://github.com/Yuriy-Nabasov/zotero-dstu-8302-2015 — MIT (LICENSE-dstu-8302-2015.txt).
              DOCXMD change: the <citation> layout prints locators — "[1, с. 33; 4]"; no doubled ". ." before the
              container title of chapters / conference papers.
locales/      CSL locales, https://github.com/citation-style-language/locales — CC BY-SA 3.0.
